title: speq suite init v1
description: An init.yaml in the suites tree, parsed as SuiteInitSpec in speq-cli/src/parser/mod.rs. Every init.yaml from the suites root down to a test's own directory applies to that test, nearest last. Any string value may carry an '${VAR}' placeholder, resolved from the OS environment when the file is loaded; '${VAR:-default}' supplies a fallback and '$${VAR}' is a literal. Substitution happens before this schema applies, so a placeholder is never itself validated against the field's type.

suite.description: All suite-level configuration. A file with no 'suite' key is valid and contributes nothing.

variables.description: Variables available to every test under this directory. A test's own variables win.

imports.description: Modules available to every test under this directory.

beforeAll.description: Steps run once before the first test in this suite.

beforeEach.description: Steps run before each test in this suite.

afterEach.description: Steps run after each test in this suite.

afterAll.description: Steps run once after the last test in this suite.
